title: Obey is Better Than Sacrifice
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the brave start, and tonight Saul obeys only partway and makes excuses: Beau is tempted to shove his toys under the bed and call his room clean, and chooses to do the whole job.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because doing the whole job, not just the easy part, takes a big, brave heart. In Beau’s world today: Mom says, “Please clean your whole room before we go to the park.” Beau makes his bed fast. Then he looks at the mountain of toys and has an idea: shove them all under the bed! Nobody would know. But Beau stops. He pulls the toys back out and puts each one where it goes, the blocks, the cars, the books. It takes longer, and he feels tall inside when he’s done. Just like Samuel told King Saul, Beau learned that obeying all the way is better than almost.
